# The issue names "as_6_5, /Zi -enable-16bit-types /Qembed_debug". Those flags are
# incidental debug-info settings, not part of the defect: the repro fails identically
# without them on the ground-truth Debug build. variant-as-filed-*.txt captures the
# filed configuration for comparison.
#
# They are dropped here because every extra flag is another way an older release could
# reject the input and score as an invalid probe rather than as a clean run -- SKILL.md
# step 6: target the oldest profile and flag set that still shows the symptom.
# as_6_5 cannot be lowered further: DispatchMesh/amplification shaders are Shader Model 6.5.
#
# cmd-as-filed.txt preserves the original command.
-T as_6_5 -E main repro.hlsl
